text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I came to the student 
council room looking for Air Groove, and……

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"An altar to worship Shiraoki-sama on 
campus!" ...Denied.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Don't erase the magic circle I drew on 
the wall!" ...Foolish. Rejected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Please add more varieties of protein to 
the school store!" ...Under consideration.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmh... You, is it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Time to check the Suggestion Box.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's not an actual, physical "box," 
just the name of the app distributed to 
students.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Students of the academy can submit 
requests through the app at any time, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We can't be bringing every single little 
request before the council, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is why I look over the contents first 
like this and determine whether or not to 
consider it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's the school culture, but we get 
a lot of overly free-spirited requests...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to the requests of all the 
uniquely individual students at the 
academy, just reading through them all 
seems quite tough."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Please allow us to leave the dorm earlier 
in the morning. I want to run while it's 
still dark out."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Go back to sleep, Suzuka. Request 
denied.
choice_data_list: I need to work hard at my own job too.
I've got to do my best at my own job too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Go back to sleep, Suzuka. Request 
denied.
choice_data_list: I need to work hard at my own job too.
I've got to do my best at my own job too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Do you have time to kill or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so... this task itself is 
fine. I have another pile of work from a 
different matter, so please take care of 
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That went quicker than expected. Is 
that all for today's work... Hmm."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Do you still have time? If so, we are 
heading to the cafeteria."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There should be a new dessert menu item 
introduced at Hishi Akebono's request.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Even I have enough heart to show some 
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly hurried after Air Groove, who 
had huffed and walked ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please do. Your real work begins this 
afternoon, so don't slip up.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Or rather, did something happen 
regarding that matter to make you come 
here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can lend you an ear. Make it quick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thoroughly coordinated with Air Groove 
regarding our afternoon training session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Air Groove apparently powered 
through her backlog of tasks one after 
another...
